description:
You are a building energy manager using Emoncms to monitor a 3 kW rooftop solar PV system. The solar generation feed ('solar_gen') has been corrupted by a sensor communication error — 5 data points show readings of approximately 50,000 W, which is physically impossible for a 3 kW system.

Your task:
1. Navigate to the Feeds page and find the 'solar_gen' feed
2. Inspect the feed's data to identify the 5 corrupted data points (values around 50,000 W). You can view the feed graph by clicking on it, or query the data via the API: http://localhost/feed/data.json?id=FEED_ID&start=START_MS&end=END_MS&interval=SECONDS&apikey=APIKEY
3. For each corrupted data point, determine a reasonable replacement value by looking at surrounding readings. Valid solar generation values are between 0 W (nighttime) and approximately 3,500 W (peak).
4. Correct each corrupted point using the Emoncms insert API: http://localhost/feed/insert.json?id=FEED_ID&time=UNIX_TIMESTAMP_SECONDS&value=CORRECTED_VALUE&apikey=APIKEY
5. Your admin Read/Write API key is available on the My Account page (http://localhost/user/view) or via: http://localhost/user/get.json

IMPORTANT:
- The feed ID can be found on the Feeds list page or via http://localhost/feed/list.json?apikey=APIKEY
- Timestamps in feed/data.json responses are in milliseconds, but feed/insert.json expects seconds
- All 5 corrupted values must be replaced with values between 0 and 4,000 W
- You may use the browser address bar or a terminal with curl to make API calls
- After fixing, verify your corrections by re-checking the feed data
